title: NSCLC biopsy_Patient 1_Diagnosis
treatment_protocol_ch1: At time of diagnosis and at progression
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted from microdissected tumor tissue using the FFPE Tissue RNA Extraction Kit from amsbio, (Bioggio-Lugano, Switzerland), according to the manufacturers protocol. RNA quantity was assessed on a Nanodrop and quality was assessed on a Bioanalyzer
label_protocol_ch1: RNA species were identified and counted using a custom probe code set consisting of 201 genes
hyb_protocol: 100 ng RNA were incubated over night at 65°C with Nanostring probe sets
scan_protocol: Scanned with NanoString Digital analyzer with 1155 FOV
data_processing: Briefly, the negative control averages plus 2 SD were subtracted to correct for background noise and values below 0 were set to 1.  Then, the geNorm method was used to select adequate genes for normalization from the included set of 6 candidates based on their relative stability.For the final normalization, the geometric mean of the selected normalization genes was calculated and used as normalization factor. Normalized expression values were log2 transformed and samples where >50% of the probes were not detectable were removed from further analysis.
contact_institute: University and University Hopsital of Bern
